title: Clash between Chilled Water Riser and Transfer Girder TG-04

subject.value: Clash between 600mm Chilled Water Riser and Transfer Girder TG-04 at Level 02
subject.source_text_snippet: Subject: Clash between 600mm Chilled Water Riser and Transfer Girder TG-04 at Level 02

question.value: Coordinated BIM model review reveals that the 600mm diameter chilled water supply/return risers shown on DR-M-402 physically intersect post-tensioned transfer girder TG-04 (Gridline 4-D) shown on DR-S-201. Core drilling through girder TG-04 is prohibited due to high post-tensioning tendon congestion. Please provide engineering direction on riser diversion or structural sleeve allowance.
question.source_text_snippet: Coordinated BIM model review reveals that the 600mm diameter chilled water supply/return risers

response.value: Confirmed: Do not sleeve or drill transfer girder TG-04. Offset chilled water risers 1200mm westward into adjacent service riser shaft S-02 per structural sketch SK-S-201-A. Mechanical subcontractor to submit revision for additional 90-degree elbows and pipe length.
response.source_text_snippet: Confirmed: Do not sleeve or drill transfer girder TG-04. Offset chilled water risers 1200mm westward

title: Unforeseen Groundwater Table Elevation at Basement B3

subject.value: Unforeseen High Water Table Elevation during Basement Level 3 Excavation
subject.source_text_snippet: Subject: Unforeseen High Water Table Elevation during Basement Level 3 Excavation

question.value: During final bulk excavation to formation level -11.50m ECD for Basement Level 3, continuous water seepage was encountered at elevation -9.80m ECD, which is 1.70m above the historical water table noted in Geotechnical Report GT-BOR-01. Current 4-inch sump pumps are overwhelmed. We request immediate authorization for continuous perimeter deep well dewatering.

title: Curtain Wall Seismic Joint Displacement Clearance

subject.value: Curtain Wall Seismic Joint Displacement Clearance at Tower Expansion Joint
subject.source_text_snippet: Subject: Curtain Wall Seismic Joint Displacement Clearance at Tower Expansion Joint

question.value: Architectural detail 4/A-501 specifies a 50mm expansion joint between the Podium and Main Tower. However, Structural General Notes S-001 indicate maximum inter-story drift under Seismic Design Category D of 75mm. Please confirm whether the facade expansion joint width must be enlarged to 85mm to prevent glass shattering.
question.source_text_snippet: Architectural detail 4/A-501 specifies a 50mm expansion joint between the Podium and Main Tower

response.value: Approved: Increase expansion joint width to 90mm at all tower interface lines. Contractor to submit revised silicone bellows extrusion profile.
response.source_text_snippet: Approved: Increase expansion joint width to 90mm at all tower interface lines.

title: Rebar Lap Splice Length in High Moment Plastic Hinge Zone

subject.value: Clarification on Column Rebar Lap Splice Length in Seismic Critical Region
subject.source_text_snippet: Subject: Clarification on Column Rebar Lap Splice Length in Seismic Critical Region

question.value: Drawing S-104 shows lap splices of 32mm vertical rebar located at slab level in Column C-12. Per ACI 318 Section 18.7.4.3, lap splices in special moment frames are prohibited within the plastic hinge region (within 600mm or d of the joint face). Please confirm if mechanical type-2 couplers must be used instead.
question.source_text_snippet: Drawing S-104 shows lap splices of 32mm vertical rebar located at slab level in Column C-12

response.value: Confirmed: Replace all lap splices in Columns C-08 through C-16 at Levels 1-4 with Type 2 seismic mechanical couplers.
response.source_text_snippet: Confirmed: Replace all lap splices in Columns C-08 through C-16 at Levels 1-4 with Type 2 seismic mechanical couplers.

question.value: The specified motorized combination fire/smoke damper model Ruskin FSD-60 is discontinued by manufacturer. We propose substituting Greenheck Model FSD-211 which meets identical 1-1/2 hour UL 555 and UL 555S Class II leakage ratings. Please confirm acceptability.

response.value: Accepted as equal. Submit formal material submittal SUB-MEP-088 for resident engineer stamp.
